attempts.summary: Created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (Alpine Linux) and installed it as a trusted system CA. Verified trust functionally (openssl verify against a leaf cert issued by the CA succeeds using the system trust store). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot_id changed post-restart, and re-verified the CA file and system trust chain survived and remain functional.
